sn35.28:1.1: evamme sutaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā gayāyaṃ viharati gayāsīse saddhiṃ bhikkhusahassena.
sn35.28:1.5: cakkhuṃ bhikkhave ādittaṃ rūpā ādittā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ ādittaṃ cakkhusamphasso āditto yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi ādittaṃ.
sn35.28:1.7: rāgagginā dosagginā mohagginā ādittaṃ jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi ādittanti vadāmi …pe…
sn35.28:1.8: jivhā ādittā rasā ādittā jivhāviññāṇaṃ ādittaṃ jivhāsamphasso āditto yampidaṃ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi ādittaṃ.
sn35.28:1.10: rāgagginā dosagginā mohagginā ādittaṃ jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi ādittanti vadāmi …pe…
sn35.28:1.11: mano āditto dhammā ādittā manoviññāṇaṃ ādittaṃ manosamphasso āditto yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi ādittaṃ.
sn35.28:1.13: rāgagginā dosagginā mohagginā ādittaṃ jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi ādittanti vadāmi.
sn35.28:1.14: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmiṃpi nibbindati rūpesupi nibbindati cakkhuviññāṇepi nibbindati cakkhusamphassepi nibbindati yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tasmiṃpi nibbindati …pe…
sn35.28:1.15: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tasmiṃpi nibbindati
sn35.28:1.16: nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn35.28:1.17: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
sn35.28:2.2: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandaduṃ. imasmiṃ
sn35.28:2.3: ca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne tassa bhikkhusahassassa anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsūti.
